summary: FAIL on one material blocker. Claim CLM-NET-CZ in analysis/claim_register.json declares the period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28, but audit_spec population.period is 2025-01-01..2025-03-30. Its value, 13527.24, is CZ net revenue for the spec period (62 rows). For the period the claim declares, my own recalculation from raw_data/orders.csv gives 9248.36 (43 rows), so the claim states a false fact. The country components the report reconciles to the headline therefore declare mixed periods. Both release surfaces show the figure under the spec period, which contradicts the register.
